title: Ignite Me
author: Tahereh Mafi
summary: In the third Shatter Me book, Juliette, whose touch can kill, joins the fight against the regime that rules her world and tries to trust Warner, who has been her enemy.
readIf: you have read the first two Shatter Me books and want the dystopian romance to continue.
skipIf: you have not read the earlier books or dislike lyrical, heavily stylised prose.
